summary: P0 verified: market_data_pool._normalize_daily() is the single choke point that guarantees ascending-by-date bars for every provider on BOTH cache-read and fresh-fetch paths. Ran the requested 9 pytest suites + added 10 new targeted integration tests covering (a) _normalize_daily unit contract, (b) fresh-fetch normalization by monkeypatching market_pool.execute to return descending bars, (c) cache-read normalization by seeding _db.price_cache with descending 'data', (d) downstream alpha_day_trader._snapshot_symbol correctly reads bars[-1] as today + computes pct_change from the two most recent closes, (e) integrity guard does NOT false-flag price-only quotes but DOES degrade on quote_fetch_failed / stale_bar / no_today_volume. Total 110/110 tests pass. Admin counters endpoint returns 200 with full 'funnel' block; live session already shows setups_created=6 (was 0 pre-fix), confirming production impact.

rca of the issue: Providers (Public.com broker, Alpha Vantage, Polygon) all return daily OHLCV NEWEST-first, but every consumer (alpha_day_trader._snapshot_symbol, public_equity_live_executor, market_regime, fast_intraday_regime) reads bars[-1] as today's session. Result: OLDEST bar (months stale) was treated as today, pct_change computed from stale closes, all candidates collapsed into the low-vol opportunity floor => 0 setups from 16,138 candidates. Fix: single normalization point _normalize_daily() in services/market_data_pool.py::market_daily() sorts by date ISO string ascending on both cache-read (line 635) and fresh-fetch (line 644) paths. Verified: (1) unit contract on _normalize_daily, (2) fresh-fetch path via monkeypatch of market_pool.execute returning descending list, (3) cache-read path by seeding _db.price_cache with descending data, (4) _snapshot_symbol picks newest bar_date and computes correct pct_change, (5) integrity guard still catches degraded feeds without false-flagging healthy price-only quotes. Live admin counters show setups_created=6 in current session.
